The following events took place in '''350 BBY'''.

==Events==
*With [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] support,<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> and chartered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] is created by a number of influential shipping and commodities companies for [[Politics/Legends|political]] gain<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and to regulate commerce in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> by mediating disputes between differing companies.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Births==
*[[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
